data.body: **[P2] Support every terminal status returned by polling.** This now settles on `CANCELLED`, `TIMED_OUT`, and `STOPPED`, but `get()` dereferences `op.stepDetails().error()` for every non-success status and replay accepts only `SUCCEEDED`/`FAILED`. A terminal response without step details therefore becomes an NPE or replay-time `IllegalDurableOperationException`, potentially failing the whole execution. Extend replay and `get()` to handle all terminal statuses null-safely, and add end-to-end polling and replay tests for them.
